g.text: p=0.007 cannot distinguish Reading A (biology) vs B (arm) vs C (noise); standard null blind to C; test battery specified as open items #1 and #7. Exploratory within-arm reads (Results 6-7) point away from pure arm membership but are not conclusive — naive Spearman p at n=8-19 with sign flips across arms is exactly what noise looks like at these sample sizes. The arm-aware null (item #1) decides.

g.text: Fat (rho=-0.320, no null, Colab T4 5-fold 226 features) and tandem (rho=-0.430, MAE null p=0.81, Colab T4 LOOCV 235 features) are silent; 34/35 matrix cells silent. CONDITIONAL because fat and tandem never received the primary harness (full 628-width, LOOCV, 1000-shuffle Spearman null). Given the width-sweep finding that BMD signal emerges only at full width, these silences may be harness artifacts. Reruns elevated to open items #2-3. The dissociation framing (published effect -> silence; no published effect -> signal) holds as an observation but is conditional until reruns complete.
